testing_evidence.evidence: Both transport cases use one real SnServer, two authenticated P2pStack clients, Report-driven online state, the public rendezvous_via_sn path, an exact target notification, a held action-before-response acknowledgement, rejection and wrong-version failure over the selected command tunnel.

Independently named TCP and QUIC cases assert a non-zero loopback SN listener, matching client listener protocol, online registration and non-zero command tunnel IDs classified by the exact SN endpoint before running the same behavioral matrix.

The complete u8 PackageCmdCode conversion domain is compared with an exact ten-role inventory; the real TCP/QUIC DV then exercises Report QA, Query QA, Call QA, Called/CalledResp and Rendezvous/Notify QA including success and protocol-appropriate failure cases.
